claim_ceiling: Draft case-specific anchors only; no frozen Rubric Version, rater calibration or scored use.

dimensions.anchor_2: States a plausible cause but treats it as fact.
dimensions.anchor_3: Maps multiple causes to observations and constraints.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Reframes container/handling/measurement boundaries and explains what remains unknown; `NA` only if the case facts were not delivered.
dimensions.label: representation
dimensions.observable_evidence: Names goal, cost constraint, evidence and uncertainty; distinguishes observed damage from proposed mechanism.

dimensions.anchor_2: Suggests a test that would detect damage but not distinguish causes.
dimensions.anchor_3: Proposes a feasible comparison that separates at least two models.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Predicts different outcomes under competing models and names a confound; `NA` only if the test probe was omitted.
dimensions.label: assumption/causal test
dimensions.observable_evidence: Identifies assumptions and a discriminating observation or test.

dimensions.anchor_2: Two wordings of one idea or two paths with one infeasible.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Several distinct paths with explicit conditions for choosing among them; `NA` only if alternatives were not requested.
dimensions.label: viable diversity
dimensions.observable_evidence: Offers meaningfully different explanation/intervention paths, each linked to a mechanism.

dimensions.anchor_2: Some novel element with uncertain use or fit.
dimensions.anchor_3: A non-obvious, workable change tied to the evidence.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: A useful reframe that survives the reveal and anticipates a limitation; `NA` only if invention was not requested. Familiarity and domain expertise are recorded as rivals, not score discounts.
dimensions.label: useful originality
dimensions.observable_evidence: Best developed intervention changes a mechanism or framing and could meet the goal.

dimensions.anchor_2: Plausible idea but no decisive feasibility check.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Test could falsify the preferred solution, with next step if it fails; `NA` only if no feasibility prompt was delivered.
dimensions.label: feasibility/evidence
dimensions.observable_evidence: Addresses mass/complexity, testing cost, sample protection and disconfirmation.

dimensions.anchor_2: Mentions reveal but keeps plan without causal explanation.
dimensions.anchor_3: Changes confidence, test or intervention consistently.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Explains why prior belief changed or held, preserves alternate cause and specifies residual uncertainty; `NA` if reveal not delivered.
dimensions.label: revision
dimensions.observable_evidence: Explicitly updates or defends the model after vibration evidence.
